DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 12 s. 2023 10 2023 HON. JASMIN N. PINSOY-LAGUTIN Sangguniang Panlalawigan Member Province of Zamboanga del Norte Legislative Building, Capitol, Dipolog City Dear Hon. Pinsoy-Lagutin: This has reference to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Resolution No. 905, series of 2022 referring to this Department for legal opinion the composition of the Provincial Peace and Order Council (PPOC) of Zamboanga del Norte created thru Executive Order No. 03, series of 2022, particularly the inclusion of the Provincial Administrator as Co- Chairman thereof. Per the Resolution, the subject EO was issued by Provincial Governor Rosalina G. Jalosjos, and organized the PPOC of Zamboanga del Norte and provided, among others, the composition thereof, which included the Provincial Administrator as Co- Chairman. It was represented that the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Zamboanga del Norte issued SP Resolution No. 668, series of 2022 requesting the Provincial Governor to review and rectify the subject EO in relation to the applicable provisions of the Local Government Code, applicable executive orders, and the DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2019-143. It was then mentioned in the Resolution that the Provincial Governor responded and upheld the composition of the PPOC as provided in the subject EO. She mentioned that the Provincial Administrator is a co-chairman of the PPOC in his capacity as the alter ego of the Provincial Governor. Hence, the request for legal opinion. At the outset, may we invite your attention to Section I(c) of Executive Order No. 773, series of 2009, to wit: "(c) The Provincial Peace and Order Council (PPOC) shall be composed of the provincial counterparts of the departments, offices and agencies as enumerated in paragraph (a) above, wherever applicable with the Provincial Governor as Chairman and the Vice Governor as Vice Chairman. In addition, there shall be one representative of the Sangguniang Lalawigan to be chosen by it from among its members. The Chairman of the PPOC shall appoint the three (3) representatives of the private sector, upon consultation with the members of the Council and with the approval of the Commander of the Infantry Division and the Regional Director of the PNP. The provincial counterpart of the CSAFP shall be the Brigade Commander or, or in the case of Palawan, the "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Commander of the Western Command, Departments, offices and agencies with no provincial and/or field offices shall not sit in the PPOC."(Emphasis and underlining supplied) While item 5.3.1 of DILG Memorandum Circular 2019-143 specifically provides: "The PPOC shall be composed of the following: • Provincial Governor; • Provincial Vice-Governor; One (I) Representative from the Sangguniang Panlalawigan-the Chairperson of the Committee on Peace and Order and Public Safety; • Provincial counterparts of the department, offices, and agencies, as enumerated in number 5.1.1 above, wherever applicable; and • Three (3) representatives from Civil Society Organizations" From the foregoing, it is clear that only the Provincial Governor can be the chairman of the PPOC, and it is to be emphasized that nowhere in the EO 773 series of 2209 and the DILG MC 2019-143 state that a Provincial Administrator may be included as a Co- Chairman of the PPOC or act as the alter-ego of the Provincial Governor. A cardinal rule in statutory construction is that when the law is clear and free from any doubt or ambiguity, there is no room for construction or interpretation. There is only room for application. As the statute is clear, plain, and free from ambiguity, it must be given its literal meaning and applied without attempted interpretation. 1 Thus, we find the EO No. 3, series of 2022 of the Province of Zamboanga del Norte inconsistent with the prevailing policies. We are of the view that the Provincial Vice- Governor, as Vice-Chairman of the PPOC, should preside in the absence of the Provincial Governor. Accordingly and pursuant to the general supervisory power of the DILG Secretary over local government units and their officials, we have already advised the Governor of Zamboanga del Norte of the foregoing in order to rectify her EO. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AU ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ANV TOR R. LLAMAS U de cretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affair S LNJVRULLLS-LRALLD/lasm/clp Copy furnished: DIR. PAIZAL O.
